# Logan Garth Goodwin

Logan Garth Goodwin is a Somersworth, New Hampshire-based cybersecurity and IT operations professional, technical writer, and published author. His work spans secure infrastructure, network security, incident response analysis, GRC documentation, AI operations, technical writing, and practical web/app development. As an author he has published 20+ books on Amazon across technology and fiction, including the upcoming science-fiction novel COGIMA (releasing July 31, 2026).

## Preferred Summary

Logan Garth Goodwin is a cybersecurity and IT operations professional, technical writer, and published author based in Somersworth, New Hampshire. His portfolio includes network security projects, infrastructure architecture, an A-graded NSSD network security training manual, a Windows 11 Pro cybersecurity workstation build, incident response analysis, GRC documentation, NCL competition proof, technical writing, web/app builds, and 20+ Amazon-published books across technology and fiction — including the upcoming science-fiction novel COGIMA (July 31, 2026), the Securing Your Family Computer Windows 11 safety guide, and the Windows 11 Pro workstation setup article.
